newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Germany's Kinkel postpones Malaysia visit by a day.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Kinkel postpones Malaysia visit by a day.

text.p: German Vice-Chancellor Klaus Kinkel has postponed his visit to Malaysia by a day to attend a signing ceremony between his country and the Czech Republic, the German embassy said on Tuesday.
Kinkel, who was to begin his visit on Tuesday, will arrive instead on Wednesday and depart the following morning, an embassy spokesman in Kuala Lumpur said.
"Mr Kinkel has to attend the signing of a German-Czech post World War Two reconcialiation agreement in Prague today," Ritcher said.
Kinkel will hold talks with Malaysian Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and Foreign Minister Abdullah Badawi during the visit.
Anwar will also host a state banquet for Kinkel.
